slices.focus: Dispatch pilot becomes signed one-page turnover template for accountability.
slices.summary: Armed with three months of board photos, annotations, and a spreadsheet separating weather holds from crew and paperwork delays, Jae-hyun gets approval for a signed one-page turnover template tied to the common board. Both day and night dispatchers must sign, with fields for vessel status, pending items, delay source, and next action, creating one shared reality instead of competing memories.
open_loops: Integrating template with existing board culture
